ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes, including the use of shell companies and money laundering techniques.
questions: How are Medicaid fraud schemes using shell companies to launder money?
What are the most common money laundering techniques used in these schemes?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and complexity of Medicaid fraud schemes. This investigation could lead to the identification of key players and the recovery of losses.
